style: Close-up realistic food photograph: the dish fills almost the entire frame, shot slightly from above at a 30-45 degree angle, served on tableware that suits the dish. Plain, softly blurred neutral background with no furniture, windows, table edges, cutlery or napkins. Soft natural light, true-to-life colours and portion size, appetizing home cooking, not over-styled. No text, no labels, no logos, no people, no hands.

dishes.spaghetti-bolognese: Spaghetti bolognese: a nest of spaghetti topped with a rich slow-cooked minced beef and tomato sauce with small pieces of carrot, finished with freshly grated parmesan, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.
dishes.kylling-i-karry: Danish 'kylling i karry': mild creamy yellow curry with chunks of chicken breast, onion and strips of red bell pepper, served over fluffy white rice, in a deep ceramic bowl.
dishes.ovnlaks-kartofler: Oven-baked salmon fillet with lemon slices, crispy roasted potato wedges, steamed broccoli florets and a small bowl of dill crème fraîche, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.tacos: Friday tacos: two soft flour tortillas filled with spiced minced beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, cucumber, sweetcorn, grated cheese and a dollop of crème fraîche, on a flat plate.
dishes.frikadeller: Classic Danish frikadeller (pan-fried pork and veal meatballs, golden brown) with boiled new potatoes and a small bowl of thinly sliced cucumber salad in vinegar, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.stegt-flaesk: Danish stegt flæsk med persillesovs: crispy fried pork belly slices, boiled potatoes and a creamy white parsley sauce full of chopped green parsley, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.koteletter-i-fad: Pork chops baked in a dish with a creamy paprika and mushroom sauce, served with white rice, in a small oven dish.
dishes.polsegryde: Danish pølsegryde: sliced sausages with onion and red bell pepper in a creamy tomato sauce, served over white rice, in a deep bowl.

dishes.chili-con-carne: Chili con carne with minced beef, kidney beans and bell pepper in a thick spicy tomato sauce, served with rice and a dollop of crème fraîche, in a deep bowl.
dishes.carbonara: Pasta carbonara: spaghetti in a silky egg and parmesan sauce with crispy bacon pieces and plenty of black pepper, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.

dishes.kikaertecurry: Chickpea curry with spinach in a creamy coconut tomato sauce, served with white rice, in a deep bowl.

dishes.frittata: Oven-baked frittata with sliced potatoes, spinach and crumbled feta, cut into wedges, with a small green salad on the side, in a cast-iron pan.
dishes.hjemmelavet-pizza: Homemade thin-crust pizza with tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and red bell pepper, on a wooden pizza board.
